title: Forwarding
description: Domains and endpoints the mock forwards to a real service instead of answering itself. Per-environment configuration, read at boot; never part of a contract set.

Forward.description: One domain or one endpoint, and where it goes. Exactly one of domain and endpoint.

domain.description: A domain the contracts declare, by the name of its directory. Every route it declares is forwarded.

endpoint.description: One route the contracts declare, as its route key: method, a space, then the path with OpenAPI {param} templates. Overrides a domain entry for that route.

to.description: Absolute base URL of the real service. Its path, if any, is a prefix: the request's own path is appended to it. May not carry a username or password: this file is configuration, and a credential belongs to the target, or to a header the caller sends and includeHeaders names.

includeHeaders.description: Headers to pass along beyond the default set, in either direction. Anything not named here or in the default set is dropped, credentials included.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the real service before answering 504. Defaults to 10000.
